items.title: Anthropic’s Nasdaq debut
items.title_zh: Anthropic 以代码 ANT 登陆纳斯达克，成为 AI 行业里程碑式 IPO
items.title_en: Anthropic Debuts on Nasdaq Under Ticker ANT, a Landmark AI IPO
items.summary: Anthropic made its public-market debut on Nasdaq, prompting intense discussion about AI valuations, competitive implications for OpenAI, and the future of software engineering jobs.

items.title: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
items.title_zh: Anthropic 称 Claude 解决了两项黑洞物理开放问题
items.title_en: Anthropic says Claude solved two open problems in black hole physics
items.summary: Anthropic reports that Claude solved two open problems in black hole physics, prompting discussion about the significance of the results and the perils of anthropomorphizing model achievements.

items.title: UK government forced to admit it issued Apple a secret encryption order
items.title_zh: 英国政府被迫承认曾向苹果发出秘密加密命令
items.title_en: UK government admits it served Apple a secret encryption order
items.summary: The UK government was compelled to disclose that it issued Apple a secret Technical Capability Notice demanding encryption access, a story broken via confidential security briefings rather than a leak, per a newly published Investigatory Powers Tribunal judgement.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 19 发布：新增 WAIT FOR LSN，因 AI 报告的漏洞而延迟
items.title_en: PostgreSQL 19 released with WAIT FOR LSN, delayed by AI-reported vulnerabilities
items.summary: PostgreSQL 19 ships with notable features including the WAIT FOR LSN command for read-your-writes consistency on standby replicas, after a delayed release cycle driven by a surge of AI-reported vulnerabilities.

items.title: 多国政府和商业网站因 PHP 严重漏洞紧急下线  PHP 于 10 月 21 日发布紧急修复补丁，处理潜伏十余年的严重漏洞，荷兰、丹麦、芬兰、法国等多国政府网站
items.title_zh: PHP 严重漏洞触发紧急补丁，多国网站预防性下线
items.title_en: Emergency PHP Patch Follows Severe Vulnerability, Prompting Website Takedowns
items.summary: A severe PHP vulnerability prompted an emergency patch and precautionary takedowns of government and commercial websites worldwide, with security agencies urging immediate updates.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 模型助力芯片设计，AMD 旗舰 GPU 提升 14%
items.title_zh: OpenAI模型优化芯片设计，AMD旗舰GPU PPA最高提升14%
items.title_en: OpenAI models optimize chip design, boost AMD GPU PPA up to 14%
items.summary: OpenAI says its models helped optimize its Jalapeño inference chip and AMD GPU designs, achieving up to 14% PPA improvements, and announced a GPT-Synopsys collaboration.
